games.name: A Broken Dream
games.desc:
A story game with horror aspects inspired by liminal spaces, dreamcore, and weirdcore. This is NOT a backrooms game.

The dream pills put the user in a guaranteed state of permanent sleep, bound to be wandering in their own lucid dreams forever. Escape reality and enter a surreal paradise, where anything your mind thinks of comes true.

Supports both singleplayer and multiplayer. Supports PC, Mobile, and Console.

Created mostly as a solo project;

Inspired by dreamcore, weirdcore, liminal spaces, the backrooms, but mostly the first two. The game’s environment has very unique and amazing aesthetics.

The game also has an original soundtrack (OST) completely made by Snoogle (the solo developer mentioned previously). 

Feel free to leave feedback or support the game.

Fanart Thumbnail Creators: kenzie4076, enoskevich, Porkparrot
